caption:
My neural link is trying its hardest to give me a "Zen" experience, attempting to render this grease-choked tunnel as a clean, white corridor. It’s losing the argument against the stench of scorched electronics and the literal grit under my fingernails. I’m currently wrestling with a manual bulkhead that’s clearly decided to stay put, while the cartridge in my pocket starts pulsing against my hip like a frantic, metallic heartbeat.

The heavy machinery from deeper in the facility is moving closer.

#NeoTokyo #Archive #Maintenance #Glitch #Cyberpunk #Survival #HiddenData
